title: The Legend of the Mix Master
overview: Mad scientist Joeb attempts to mix Gamebridge City with the Game World. Meanwhile, Prince Brad - Evil Lord of the Game World - starts an invasion. In order to save mankind, a regular kid named Ditt must rise and become our hero, the "Mix Master".

title: Hench Invasion
overview: Hench monsters have taken over Gamebridge City. Humans and Hench are on the brink of an all-out war. Our reluctant hero Ditt must restore order to prevent any more destruction.

title: The Pie Is Delicious
overview: Poy befriends an orphan hench named Penguinsa, and Prince Brad sends his minion Chino to intervene. Chino transforms Penguinsa into an evil attack-hench, leaving Poy helpless to defend herself.

title: Black Belt Girl
overview: Ditt's friend Penril is a well-trained Black Belt. When the dark elf Mino turns one of Penril's students against her, a practice fight becomes the real thing. In the battle that follows, we learn that Ditt may not be the only Mix Master.

title: Going To Work With Dad!
overview: Prince Brad and his goons are making life miserable for Gamebridge again. This time they've taken over Ditt's dad's office! What will happen when an ordinary Monday morning becomes Take-your-evil-Hench-to-work Day!?

title: Cheek, Mix Master?
overview: Cheek is so eager to become a Mix Master that he falls victim to a slick Hench scam artist anmed Koala. Now, he will have to figure out who his true friends are before he can learn to be a real hero.

title: Rivals
overview: Ditt and friends enter a talent contest, but fall under a spell cast by Prince Brad's minion Chino and his punk rock guitar. With Gambridge in grave danger, Jin is their last hope, but he must decide if it is more important to save the city or see Ditt fail.

title: Sports day
overview: A special sports day is held, finally bringing humans and hench together for a friendly competition. But while Jin and Ditt are preoccupied with beating one another, the evil Jamine uses her mind control to quickly take control of the competitors.

title: Orb of the black tempest
overview: Ditt and his friends try to help a group of overworked construction Henches, but Prince Brad's thug, Mino, turns them evil! Everyone must work together to stop Mino and teach the construction manager a lesson about treating his employees with respect.

title: Mister Blaster goes Ballistic
overview: An enthusiastic new teacher comes to Ditt's school, but his first day is ruined when the villainess Jamine brainwashes all of his Hench students.

title: Chino's such a drag
overview: Chino disguises himself as Poy and sneaks into Ditt's house to steal his Mix Master card shuffler. But Chino's plan gets ruined when he can't resist the home-cooked meal from Ditt's mother.

title: Jin's Secret
overview: Penril brings Ditt and Jin together in attempt to make the boys reconcile. Despite their resistance, the boys must find a way to work together and save Jin's father, the mayor of Gambridge, against dark elves.

title: Mix Master Challenge
overview: Dr.Joeb proclaims Ditt is the Mix Master, but Jin is determined to challenge him for the title. As the two boys engage in a Hench battle, the evil Prince's thugs seize the opportunity. Henches, action and the true Mix Master!

title: Sound Bites and Photo Ops
overview: A reality TV show follows the daily lives of Ditt and Jin. In an attempt to be on TV too, Prince Brad's thugs attack the boys and the cameras capture an amazing battle, until something goes dangerously wrong, leaving Poy to become the star of the show.

title: The Expedition!
overview: It's a race to find the Master Hench. Prince Brad is running at full speed and so are Ditt and his friends. Who will be the winner?

title: Star Struck!
overview: Rumor has it that a celebrity Hench visiting Gambridge is actually the Master Hench! Ditt and his friends discover she's been brainwashed and her new movie is about to become a disaster flick unless they can save her!

title: Shadow
overview: When a mysterious Hench steals from Gambridge's rich and gives to the poor, the kids are convinced that this must be the Master Hench. But Prince Brad has the same idea and plots to get to the Hench before they do!

title: Guru-Ga
overview: Ditt's classroom is visited by a guest speaker, a mystical Hench named Guru-Ga. It turns out that the Guru's mystical powers are not as advertised, and the kids must jump into action to save him from a Dark-Elf attack.

title: Cave Creatures!
overview: Ditt and his friends learn of a giant dragon living under Gambridge's streets. Rumor has it that this is the Master Hench. When the kids learn he is not, they must defend the helpless dragon from Prince Brad.

title: The Doctor Joeb Workout!
overview: Dr. Joeb enrolls Ditt and friends in a bizarre training program to battle the Dark-Elves. Along the way, they find a collection of hidden artifacts, leading to Dr. Joeb's revelation of a long-kept secret of his own ancestry.

title: Flower Power!
overview: Prince Brad sends the evil Giara to defeat Ditt and his friends. Giara fills the town with flowers that turn into monsters. Ditt and his friends must counter the attack before the town is overrun with monsters.

title: Gone Fishing
overview: A strange creature has been sighted out at the lake. Believing this creature is the Master Hench, the kids and the Dark Elves engage in a battle to reach it first, only to discover it's just Dr. Joeb in one of his latest and strangest contraptions.

title: Pachi's Secret
overview: When all of the kids have the same dream on the same night, they decide to follow the clues in the dream. They discover it was a trap set by Giara, and with no one left to save them, Pachi has no choice but to reveal his secret identity!

title: To Catch A Hench
overview: With his true identity revealed, Pachi is no longer safe in Gambridge. Fearing that he has put Ditt's family in danger, Pachi attempts to flee but ends up kidnapped by Prince Brad and his goons.

title: Operation "Rescue Pachi
overview: After nabbing Pachi, Prince Brad believes he has everything he needs to finalize the mixture of Atreia and Gambridge. But he didn't count on Ditt's resilience and determination to save both worlds once and for all!

title: Eternal Revival
overview: In the ultimate battle, Ditt and Pachi use their powers to permanently put an end to Prince Brad and his evil plans. Although they win a the first battle against the Prince, Gambridge is no longer safe and Pachi must retreat deep into Atreia.

title: Atreia
overview: To bring Pachi back, Ditt and friends travel into Atreia and find a world filled with monsters and magic. Unbeknownst to the kids, Prince Brad has sent his field commander, Grom, to stop them.

title: Stage Struck
overview: Poy's mother has been captured by Dark-Elves, but the kids soon learn it's all part of Giara's plan to lure the group into an ambush. Ditt must try something that's never been done before if he's going to save them all.

title: The Coral Marble
overview: Ditt and friends arrive in Poy's hometown, only to find hostile villagers reluctant to believe that Ditt is their hero. As Poy struggles to convince them, even Ditt begins to feel self-doubt.

title: Trust Me
overview: To gain the elves' trust, Ditt and his friends do battle with an army of Dark Elves that threatens Poy's village. After proving himself, Ditt receives key help from the good elves. At their urging, he sets out to destroy the Ove, a mysterious artifact used by the Dark Elves to control the Hench and turn them into evil monsters.

title: Bogosity
overview: With the help of the Elves, Ditt learns that the Master Hench has fled to a secret place called The Shrine of Ilyria. According to legend, only the Mix Master and his allies can enter this shrine which is located in the crags on a rugged mountaintop. Ditt and his friends set out in search of Ilyria.

title: Do Cards Grow on Trees?
overview: Ditt and his friends arrive at the shrine of Ilyria, looking for Pachi. However, four powerful Guardian Hench protect the shrine from intruders. Ditt must defeat the guardians to prove that he is worthy to enter the shrine.

title: The Gates of Twilight
overview: Ditt and his friends enter the mystical Shrine of Ilyria where they learn the truth about the legend of the Mix Master. At last, Ditt finds Pachi, but Pachi tells him he can't return to the human world. Before he can explain, Prince Brad breaks into the shrine and snatches Pachi away, proclaiming that he will take control of the Master Hench's infinite power and use it to conquer the human world.

title: Ancient Wisdom
overview: Worried about their homes and families, Ditt and his friends return quickly to the human world only to find that it has changed drastically. While they were away in Atreia, Prince Brad used mind-control to turn the hench into an evil army. Now, Ditt and his group will have to fight their own Hench friends.

title: The Sphere of Darkness
overview: Prince Brad is preparing to harness the infinite power of the Master Hench. Ditt and his friends cross into the dark-elf world and try to intercept Prince Brad at his fortress. At the same time, Prince Brad's hench begin to mount dangerous attacks all over the human world.

title: Making Friends with the Enemy
overview: Ditt and his friends break into the fortress and find Prince Brad and Giara who are draining Pachi of his power so they can use it for their own evil plans. Ditt tries to stop them, but Prince Brad holds him off as Giara laughs triumphantly: she has completed the process. But what Giara reveals next surprises even Prince Brad.

title: The Wraith of the Lost World!
overview: The resurrected Wraith of the Lost World can bring the Human and Hench worlds to ruin with the force of his overwhelming power. In an attempt to counter this threat, Humans, Hench, and even the Dark-Elves - support Ditt and his friends as they prepare to rescue their worlds from doom.

title: The Ultimate Hench
overview: Battling with the Wraith of the Lost World, Ditt's allies are defeated one by one until only Ditt and Pachi remain. Strengthened by their sincere bond of friendship and empowered by the faith of the good people of the world, Ditt experiences a miracle. The ancient Mix Master of legend awakens the warrior within Ditt, and Pachi suddenly recovers his powers as Master Hench.

title: The Final Battle
overview: Ditt and Pachi fight a mighty battle against the Wraith of the Lost World. With a supreme effort, they seal the Wraith away, back in his prison -- but his imprisonment will not be permanent until Atreia and the real world are separated again. To accomplish this, Ditt must go back to Gamebridge City and return it to its former state. His work as Mix Master is just beginning...
